project_type: Next.js App Router with Prisma ORM - digital event invitation platform
build_system: Next.js (npx next build). Prisma generate runs before build. Deployed on Vercel.
test_framework: No test framework configured. Validation is via build success.
verification_instructions: Run npx next build and confirm it exits with code 0. All routes should appear in the output.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma Client is generated via 'npx prisma generate'. The .next/ directory is the build output (gitignored).
setup_instructions: npm install, then npx prisma generate. Build with npx next build.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. No DATABASE_URL configured (uses placeholder from .env.example). Build works without DB connection since Prisma only needs to generate client types.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md says: Read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ guides before writing code. Next.js 16 with App Router. Params in dynamic routes are Promises (must await params).
key_patterns: 1) Prisma singleton in src/lib/prisma.ts. 2) API routes use NextResponse, return JSON. 3) Rate limiting via src/lib/rate-limit.ts. 4) Validation via Zod schemas in src/lib/validators.ts. 5) Admin auth via middleware checking admin_session cookie (cookie-based, not JWT). 6) Dynamic pages use 'params: Promise<{...}>' pattern (Next.js 16). 7) Client components use 'use client' directive. 8) Already has html5-qrcode and qrcode.react in dependencies. 9) Already has uuid package. 10) Existing /api/checkin route validates rsvpId and marks attended. 11) Existing /admin/events/[id]/puerta page has QR scanner using Html5QrcodeScanner.
directory_structure: src/app/ - Next.js App Router pages and API routes. src/components/ - React components (templates, shared). src/lib/ - utilities (prisma, auth, validators, rate-limit). prisma/ - schema and migrations. public/ - static files.
